text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Hoo, hoo—!
..."Up quark", looking good keeping this pace.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that person over there...
Is Universe-san doing early morning practice too? Wait—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Universe-saaan!
Do you have a moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Your running just now was so refined.
Are you doing any special training?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I thought it felt very similar to the running forms used during training overseas... especially in Europe!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Special... "MABTE."
That expression might be quite fitting.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This is something Neo Universe's "developer"—
her Trainer—and she "devised" together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Research into boosting abilities...
The "materials" can be sourced from anywhere, domestic or abroad—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Next is the European races...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Analysis"—the "rhythm" is different, yes.
Because it requires "stamina"...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd definitely like to incorporate this.
Yeah, we should definitely incorporate this.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"UNDY"—Establishing a "rhythm"
requires long-term training, yes.
choice_data_list: How about borrowing the power of your favorite music?
How about borrowing the power of music you love?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—!
"Listening" and "running", together...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The music is "harmonizing" with Neo Universe's body...
"CDR"—both "validity" and "expectation values" are high, yes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Race footage 'collected' by Trainer, 'IDE' for 'training'... meaningful."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "code" is... 『Establish a rhythm』.
Align 『tough soil』 and 『sound』, then 『run』.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Building a rhythm to tackle heavy track conditions...
I see, how intriguing.
Was this early morning training your Trainer's idea too?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This is—'independent training.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"A 'method' for Neo Universe's sake.
A 'rendezvous' of thoughts... with Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"THRF"—could be called a "favorite."
So, let us continue... "Hubble."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really is special to you, isn't it?
Feelings included, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much! Thank you for sharing,
Universe-san! I'll be sure to use it as a reference!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative.
The "expected value" will surely be satisfied.
